description: (Audit 2019) Average travel time to nearest public primary school by public transport during 2031 AM peak is a dataset listed in Australian Government open data portal (data.gov.au), an open data portal, published or maintained by Infrastructure Australia. This layer is part of strategic transport modelling undertaken for Urban Transport Crowding and Congestion, a supplementary report of the Australian Infrastructure Audit 2019. These data represent average weekday transport performance during AM peak (7am to 9am). Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Infrastructure Australia. Its tags are congestion, crowding, public transport, transport, urban transport. It offers 5 resource(s) in geojson, shp, sld, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
